title: Frappe ERPNext 5.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 5.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 have an authorization vulnerability in the Buying module. The endpoint responsible for closing and reopening Purchase Orders only verifies document-type write permissions, ignoring per-document User Permissions. This allows authenticated users with Purchase Order write access to alter the status of Purchase Orders belonging to other companies by sending crafted requests.
